en.s: A total solar eclipse, commonly referred to as the Assyrian eclipse or the Bur-Sagale eclipse, occurred on 15 June 763 BC in the proleptic Julian calendar, recorded in Assyrian eponym lists that most likely date to the tenth year of the reign of king Ashur-dan III. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between the Earth and Sun, completely or partially blocking the Sun for a viewer on Earth.

zh.s: 公元前763年6月15日发生了一次日全食，采用前推儒略历记日，通常称为亚述日食或布尔萨加莱日食。亚述同名官员年表记录了这次日食，该年表很可能对应亚述王亚述丹三世在位第十年。日食是月球运行到地球与太阳之间，全部或部分遮挡地球上观察者视野中的太阳。

en.t: Louis II is crowned as king of Italy at Rome by pope Sergius II
en.s: Louis II (825 – 12 August 875), sometimes called the Younger, was the king of Italy and emperor of the Carolingian Empire from 844, co-ruling with his father Lothair I until 855, after which he ruled alone. Louis's usual title was imperator augustus ("august emperor"), but he used imperator Romanorum ("emperor of the Romans") after his conquest of Bari in 871, which led to poor relations with the Eastern Roman Empire.

zh.t: 教宗塞尔吉乌斯二世在罗马为路易二世加冕
zh.s: 路易二世（825年—875年8月12日），又称小路易，自844年起担任意大利国王和加洛林帝国皇帝；他与父亲洛泰尔一世共同执政至855年，之后独自统治。他惯用“尊贵的皇帝”头衔，但871年征服巴里后改用“罗马人的皇帝”，使他与东罗马帝国的关系恶化。

en.s: The Battle of Soissons was fought on 15 June 923 between an alliance of Frankish insurgent nobles led by Robert I, elected king in an assembly the year prior, and an army composed of Lotharingians, Normans, and Carolingian forces under King Charles III's command. The battle took place at Soissons, near Aisne. Robert was killed, but his army won the war.

zh.s: 苏瓦松战役于923年6月15日爆发，交战双方是法兰克叛乱贵族联盟和查理三世指挥的军队。联盟由前一年在集会上当选为国王的罗贝尔一世率领；查理三世一方则由洛塔林吉亚人、诺曼人和加洛林王朝军队组成。战斗发生在埃纳省苏瓦松附近。罗贝尔阵亡，但他的军队赢得了战争。

en.s: The Battle of Fimreite (Norwegian: Slaget ved Fimreite) was a naval battle fought on June 15, 1184, between King Magnus Erlingsson and the Birkebeiner supported Sverre Sigurdsson. At this time in Norwegian history it was extremely common for there to be changes in leadership, and political coups were often conducted to establish a new ruler.

zh.s: 菲姆赖特海战（挪威语：Slaget ved Fimreite）于1184年6月15日爆发，是马格努斯·埃林松国王与得到桦腿党支持的斯韦雷·西居尔松之间的一场海战。当时挪威政权更迭十分常见，政治政变也经常被用来确立新统治者。

en.s: The Battle of Koromo River took place during the opening years of the Kamakura period (12th century) of Japan. After the destruction of the Heike, Minamoto no Yoshitsune conflicted with his brother Minamoto no Yoritomo, and fled into Hiraizumi, Mutsu Province. He was sheltered by Northern Fujiwara's 3rd ruler Fujiwara no Hidehira. Hidehira appointed Yoshitsune as general to be opposed to Yoritomo, but he died of illness on October 29, 1187.

zh.s: 衣川之战发生在日本镰仓时代初期。平家灭亡后，源义经与兄长源赖朝不和，逃往陆奥国平泉，受到奥州藤原氏第三代当主藤原秀衡庇护。秀衡任命义经为将领，以对抗赖朝，但他于1187年10月29日病逝。

en.s: The Battle of Lyndanisse or Lindanise was fought on 15 June 1219 during the North Crusades, between the forces of the invading Kingdom of Denmark and the local non-Christian Estonians. The Danish victory in the battle, at the site of the later Hanseatic city of Reval (now Tallinn, Estonia) helped King Valdemar II of Denmark to subsequently claim the territory of northern Estonia as his participation in the crusade into Estonia had been undertaken in response to calls from the Pope.

zh.s: 林丹尼斯战役也称林达尼斯战役，于1219年6月15日北方十字军东征期间爆发，交战双方是入侵的丹麦王国军队和当地非基督教爱沙尼亚人。丹麦军队在战斗中获胜；战场后来成为汉萨城市雷瓦尔（今爱沙尼亚塔林）的所在地。瓦尔德马二世参与爱沙尼亚十字军东征是响应教皇号召，因此此战胜利帮助他随后宣称拥有爱沙尼亚北部领土。

en.s: The Battle of Agridi was fought on 15 June 1232 between the forces loyal to Henry I of Cyprus (such as those of the Ibelin family) and the imperial army of Frederick II, composed mostly of men from Lombardy. It resulted in an Ibelin victory and the successful relief of the siege of Dieudamour, an Ibelin castle on Cyprus. Frederick II, as regent for his young son Conrad II of Jerusalem, appointed five bailiffs to govern Cyprus much to the displeasure of the local nobility.

zh.s: 阿格里迪战役于1232年6月15日爆发，交战双方是效忠塞浦路斯国王亨利一世的军队（包括伊贝林家族的部队）与腓特烈二世的帝国军，后者大多来自伦巴第。伊贝林家族获胜，成功解救了被围困的狄厄达穆尔城堡。腓特烈二世当时是年幼的耶路撒冷国王康拉德二世的摄政王；他任命五名官员治理塞浦路斯，这令当地贵族十分不满。

en.s: The Battle of the Leitha River was fought on 15 June 1246 near the banks of the Leitha river between the forces of the King Béla IV of Hungary and Duke Frederick II of Austria. The Hungarian army was routed, but Duke Frederick was killed, ending Austrian claims to the western counties of Hungary.

zh.s: 莱塔河战役于1246年6月15日在莱塔河岸附近爆发，交战双方是匈牙利国王贝拉四世和奥地利公爵腓特烈二世的军队。匈牙利军队溃败，但腓特烈公爵阵亡，奥地利对匈牙利西部各郡的领土主张也随之终结。

en.s: The Byzantine–Venetian treaty of 1285 was an agreement between the Byzantine Empire and the Republic of Venice that restored peaceful relations between the two powers. Venice had had troubled relations with the Byzantines after their reconquest of Constantinople in 1261, but treaties in 1268 and 1277 had allowed Venetians to conduct profitable commerce in the Empire, while safeguarding the Byzantines from attacks by the powerful Venetian navy.

zh.s: 1285年，拜占庭帝国与威尼斯共和国签订条约，恢复两国的和平关系。拜占庭人1261年重新夺回君士坦丁堡后，双方关系一度紧张；1268年和1277年的条约允许威尼斯人在帝国境内经商获利，同时保护拜占庭免受强大的威尼斯海军攻击。

en.s: The Battle of Rozgony or Battle of Rozhanovce was fought between King Charles I of Hungary and the family of Palatine Amade Aba on 15 June 1312, on the Rozgony (today Rozhanovce) field. Chronicon Pictum described it as the "most cruel battle since the Mongol invasion of Europe". Despite many casualties on the King's side, his decisive victory brought an end to the Aba family's rule over the eastern Kingdom of Hungary, weakened his major domestic opponent Máté Csák III, and ultimately secured power for Charles I of Hungary.

zh.s: 罗兹戈尼战役也称罗扎诺夫采战役，于1312年6月15日在罗兹戈尼（今罗扎诺夫采）平原爆发，交战双方是匈牙利国王查理一世和帕拉蒂尼阿玛德·阿巴家族。编年史《图像编年史》称，这是“自蒙古入侵欧洲以来最残酷的战役”。尽管国王一方伤亡惨重，但这场决定性胜利终结了阿巴家族对匈牙利东部王国的统治，削弱了查理一世在国内的主要对手马泰·恰克三世，并最终巩固了查理一世的权力。

en.s: The War of the Brabantian Succession (Dutch: Brabantse Successieoorlog, French: Guerre de la succession du Brabant) was a war of succession triggered by the death of John III, Duke of Brabant. He had no sons, and as the Duchy of Brabant had a tradition of male (agnatic) primogeniture, his three daughters and their three husbands, namely the dukes of Luxemburg and Guelders and the count of Flanders, claimed (a part of) the inheritance.

zh.s: 布拉班特公爵约翰三世去世后，继承权争议引发战争。他没有儿子，而布拉班特公国传统上实行男性长子继承。约翰的三个女儿及其丈夫——卢森堡公爵、海尔德兰公爵和佛兰德斯伯爵——都要求继承全部或部分领地。

en.s: The Battle of Kosovo took place on 15 June 1389 between an army led by the Serbian Prince Lazar Hrebeljanović and an invading army of the Ottoman Empire under the command of Sultan Murad I. It was one of the largest battles of the Late Middle Ages. The battle was fought on the Kosovo field in the territory ruled by Serbian nobleman Vuk Branković, in what is today Kosovo, about 5 kilometers (3.1 mi) northwest of the modern city of Pristina.

zh.s: 科索沃战役于1389年6月15日爆发，交战双方是拉扎尔·赫雷别利亚诺维奇亲王率领的塞尔维亚军队和穆拉德一世苏丹指挥的奥斯曼入侵军。这是中世纪晚期规模最大的战役之一。战斗发生在塞尔维亚贵族武克·布兰科维奇统治的科索沃平原，位于今科索沃境内、现代普里什蒂纳西北约5公里（3.1英里）处。

en.s: The Battle of Kosmidion (Turkish: Eyüp Muharebesi) occurred on 15 June 1410, during the Ottoman Interregnum, and was fought between the forces of the rival brothers, Musa Çelebi and Süleyman Çelebi, at Kosmidion (modern Eyüp) just outside the land walls of Constantinople.

zh.s: 科斯米迪翁战役（土耳其语：Eyüp Muharebesi）于1410年6月15日在奥斯曼帝国空位期爆发。交战双方是争夺统治权的兄弟穆萨·切莱比和苏莱曼·切莱比，战斗地点在君士坦丁堡城墙外的科斯米迪翁（今埃于普）。

en.s: During the Dano-Hanseatic War (1426–1435) the Danish capital Copenhagen was bombarded twice by ships from six Northern German Hanseatic towns. A first attack in April 1428 was repelled, but a second attack on 15 June was successful. The Danish fleet which anchored in Copenhagen was mostly destroyed, with only three ships surviving. For the first time in the Northern European history of naval warfare ship artillery was used over longer distances.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 丹麦—汉萨战争期间，来自北德意志六座汉萨城市的舰船曾两次炮击丹麦首都哥本哈根。第一次袭击发生于1428年4月，被丹麦击退；第二次袭击于6月15日成功。停泊在哥本哈根的丹麦舰队大多被摧毁，只剩3艘船。此次交战首次在北欧海战史上远距离使用舰炮。

en.s: The Battle of Meung-sur-Loire took place on 15 June 1429. It was one of Joan of Arc's battles following relief of the siege at Orléans. This campaign was the second sustained French offensive in a generation in the Hundred Years' War.

zh.s: 默恩河畔战役于1429年6月15日爆发，是圣女贞德解围奥尔良后参与的战役之一。这场战役是百年战争一代以来法国持续发动的第二次攻势。

en.s: The Battle of Girolata was a naval action fought between Genoese, Spanish and Ottoman ships on 15 June 1540 in the Gulf of Girolata, on the west coast of the island of Corsica, amidst the war between Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor, and Suleiman the Magnificent. A Christian squadron of 21 galleys led by the Genoese Gianettino Doria and the Spaniard Berenguer de Requesens surprised an Ottoman squadron of 11 galleys, anchored at Girolata, led by the Ottoman admiral Dragut, whom the commander of the Ottoman Navy, Hayreddin Barbarossa, had committed to raid the Italian coast after his victories in the Adriatic sea the year before.

zh.s: 吉罗拉塔海战于1540年6月15日在科西嘉岛西岸的吉罗拉塔湾爆发，是查理五世与苏莱曼大帝交战期间的一场海战，参战方包括热那亚、西班牙和奥斯曼帝国舰船。吉安内蒂诺·多里亚率领21艘基督教桨帆船，出其不意地袭击了停泊在吉罗拉塔、由奥斯曼海军上将德拉古特率领的11艘桨帆船。此前一年，奥斯曼海军统帅海雷丁·巴巴罗萨在亚得里亚海获胜后，命令德拉古特袭击意大利沿岸。

en.s: The Battle of Carberry Hill took place on 15 June 1567, near Musselburgh, East Lothian, a few miles east of Edinburgh, Scotland, UK. A number of Scottish lords objected to the rule of Mary, Queen of Scots after she had married the Earl of Bothwell, who was widely believed to have murdered her previous husband Lord Darnley. The Lords were intent to avenge Darnley's death. However, Bothwell escaped from the stand-off at Carberry while Queen Mary surrendered. Mary abdicated, escaped from prison, and was defeated at the battle of Langside. She went to exile in England while her supporters continued a civil war in Scotland.

zh.s: 卡伯里山战役于1567年6月15日在英国苏格兰东洛锡安的马瑟尔堡附近爆发，距爱丁堡以东数英里。苏格兰女王玛丽嫁给博思韦尔伯爵后，部分苏格兰贵族反对她的统治；许多人认为博思韦尔谋杀了玛丽此前的丈夫达恩利勋爵，贵族们决心为达恩利之死复仇。卡伯里对峙期间，博思韦尔逃脱，玛丽女王则投降。玛丽后来退位并越狱，在朗赛德战役中战败，随后流亡英格兰；她的支持者则继续在苏格兰发动内战。

en.s: English settlers at Jamestown completed their first James Fort in present-day Virginia by June 15, 1607. The triangular fort had three bulwarks fitted with artillery and was built after attacks on the new settlement. Colonist George Percy recorded its completion on the fifteenth of June; the site later became the first permanent English settlement in North America.
en.n: June 15 is the fort's recorded completion date, separate from the settlement's May 1607 founding.

zh.t: 詹姆斯敦殖民者建成詹姆斯堡
zh.s: 1607年6月15日前，英格兰殖民者在今天美国弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯敦建成第一座詹姆斯堡。堡垒呈三角形，三个角上设有配备火炮的防御工事；殖民者在新定居点遭袭后修建了它。殖民者乔治·珀西记下堡垒于6月15日完工。詹姆斯敦后来成为北美首个永久性英格兰人定居点。
zh.n: 6月15日是堡垒完工的记载日期，与1607年5月建立定居点不同。

en.s: The Battle of Rathenow (German: Schlacht um Rathenow or Überfall von Rathenow) was the first engagement between the forces of Brandenburg-Prussia and Sweden in the Swedish-Brandenburg War (also called the Scanian War). The battle took place on 15 June [O.S. 25 June] 1675 and ended with the capture of the town of Rathenow, the front of which had been occupied by Sweden, by the Brandenburg troops.

zh.s: 拉滕诺战役也称拉滕诺突袭，是勃兰登堡-普鲁士军队与瑞典军队在瑞典—勃兰登堡战争期间的首次交战。战斗于1675年6月15日（儒略历6月25日）爆发。瑞典军队占据该镇前线，勃兰登堡军队随后夺取拉滕诺。

en.s: The siege of Kaiserswerth (18 April – 15 June 1702), was a siege of the War of the Spanish Succession. Prussian and Dutch troops numbering 38,000 men and 215 artillery pieces and mortars under the command of Imperial Field Marshal Walrad, Prince of Nassau-Usingen, besieged and captured the small French fortress on the Lower Rhine, which the French had occupied without resistance the previous year.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 凯泽斯韦尔特围城战于1702年4月18日至6月15日西班牙王位继承战争期间爆发。纳绍-乌辛根亲王瓦尔拉德元帅指挥38,000名普鲁士和荷兰士兵，配备215门火炮和迫击炮，围攻并攻占莱茵河下游一座小型法国要塞。法国人曾在前一年不战而占领该要塞。

en.s: Rákóczi's War of Independence (1703–1711) was one of the most significant attempts to topple the rule of the Habsburgs over Hungary. The war was conducted by a group of noblemen and wealthy and high-ranking progressives and was led by Francis II Rákóczi; resigned soldiers and peasants also fought alongside the noblemen. The insurrection was unsuccessful, ending with the Treaty of Szatmár, by which the Hungarian nobility managed to satisfy some important Hungarian interests.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1703年至1711年的拉科齐独立战争，是推翻哈布斯堡家族对匈牙利统治的重要尝试之一。战争由费伦茨二世·拉科齐领导，参与者包括贵族、富裕且地位较高的改革派人士、退伍军人和农民。起义最终失败，以《萨特马尔和约》结束；匈牙利贵族借此满足了部分重要诉求。

en.s: The Spanish conquest of Oran and Mers el-Kebir took place from 15 June to 2 July 1732, between the Kingdom of Spain and the Deylik of Algiers. The great Spanish expedition led by José Carrillo de Albornoz, Duke of Montemar and Francisco Javier Cornejo defeated the Algerian troops under the command of the Bey of the Beylik of Oran, Mustapha Bouchelaghem, and the Wali of Oran, Hassan.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙于1732年6月15日至7月2日征服奥兰和梅尔斯埃尔凯比尔，交战双方是西班牙王国和阿尔及尔摄政区。何塞·卡里略·德·阿尔沃诺斯公爵和弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·科尔内霍率领的大规模西班牙远征军击败了奥兰贝伊国穆斯塔法·布舍拉甘和奥兰瓦利哈桑指挥的阿尔及利亚军队。

en.s: The Action of 15 June 1745 was a naval encounter between three New England vessels and a French and native relief convoy en route to relieve the Siege of Louisbourg (1745) during King George's War. The French and native convoy of four French vessels and fifty native canoes carrying 1200 fighters was led by Paul Marin de la Malgue and the New England forces were led by Captain David Donahew. The New Englanders were successful. The Governor of Ile Royal Louis Du Pont Duchambon thought that the New Englanders would have ended their siege of Louisbourg had Marin arrived.

zh.s: 1745年6月15日海战是乔治王战争期间的一次海上交战。三艘新英格兰船只袭击了一支法国和原住民组成的援军船队；该船队正前往解救遭围攻的路易斯堡。由四艘法国船只和50艘载有1,200名战士的原住民独木舟组成的船队由保罗·马兰·德·拉马尔格率领，新英格兰部队则由戴维·多纳休船长指挥。新英格兰人获胜。皇家岛总督路易·迪蓬·迪尚邦认为，如果马兰及时赶到，新英格兰人会结束对路易斯堡的围攻。

en.s: The action of 15 June 1780 was a minor naval engagement took place during the American War of Independence between a French privateer frigate and a Royal Navy 32-gun fifth-rate HMS Apollo off the coast near Ostend. In mid June HMS Apollo under the command of Philemon Pownoll was cruising in company with the 32-gun HMS Cleopatra, under Captain the Hon. George Murray.

zh.s: 1780年6月15日海战是美国独立战争期间的一次小规模海战，交战双方是法国私掠护卫舰和英国皇家海军32炮五级舰“阿波罗”号，地点在奥斯坦德附近海域。6月中旬，“阿波罗”号在菲利蒙·波诺尔指挥下与乔治·默里上校指挥的32炮“克娄巴特拉”号一同巡航。

en.s: The Battle of Wetzlar (15 June 1796) saw a Habsburg Austrian army led by Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen launch an attack on a Republican French army under Jean-Baptiste Jourdan in its defenses on the Lahn River. The War of the First Coalition action ended in an Austrian victory when most of the French army began retreating to the west bank of the Rhine River.

zh.s: 韦茨拉尔战役于1796年6月15日爆发。哈布斯堡奥地利军队由特申公爵卡尔大公率领，向拉恩河防线上的共和法国军队发起进攻，法军由让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当指挥。这是第一次反法同盟战争期间的一场战斗，最终以奥军获胜告终，大部分法军开始撤往莱茵河西岸。

en.s: The Battle of Maudach occurred on 15 June 1796 between the French Revolutionary Army and the Army of the First Coalition. This was the opening action of the Rhine Campaign of 1796 on the Upper Rhine, slightly north of the town of Kehl. The Coalition, commanded by Franz Petrasch, lost 10 percent of its manpower missing, killed or wounded.

zh.s: 毛达赫战役于1796年6月15日爆发，交战双方是法国革命军和第一次反法同盟军。这是1796年莱茵战役在上莱茵河地区的首场交战，地点位于凯尔镇以北不远处。弗朗茨·佩特拉施指挥的同盟军有10%的兵力失踪、阵亡或受伤。

en.s: The Marengo campaign (4 April – 15 June 1800) saw a Habsburg Austrian army led by General der Kavallerie Michael von Melas fight against the defending French Army of Italy under General of Division (GD) André Massena and the invading French Reserve Army commanded by First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte. In early April, Melas launched a successful offensive that split the outnumbered Army of Italy and initiated the Siege of Genoa with Massena's forces trapped within the city.

zh.s: 马伦戈战役于1800年4月4日至6月15日展开。迈克尔·冯·梅拉斯骑兵上将指挥哈布斯堡奥地利军队，与安德烈·马塞纳师将军指挥的意大利法军，以及第一执政拿破仑·波拿巴指挥的法国预备军交战。4月初，梅拉斯发动成功攻势，分割了兵力较少的意大利法军，并围攻热那亚，将马塞纳的部队困在城内。

en.t: Twelfth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Twelfth Amendment (Amendment XII) to the United States Constitution provides the procedure for electing the president and vice president. It replaced the procedure in Article II, Section 1, Clause 3, under which the Electoral College originally functioned. The amendment was proposed by Congress on December 9, 1803, and was ratified by the requisite three-quarters of state legislatures on June 15, 1804.
en.n: New Hampshire approves the Twelfth Amendment to the United States Constitution, ratifying the document.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十二修正案
zh.s: 美国宪法第十二修正案规定总统和副总统的选举程序，取代了原先依照宪法第二条第一款第三项运作的选举人团选举程序。国会于1803年12月9日提出该修正案，随后获得四分之三州议会批准，并于1804年6月15日正式生效。
zh.n: 新罕布什尔州批准美国宪法第十二修正案，使该修正案获得批准。

en.s: The Battle of María (15 June 1809) saw a small Spanish army led by Joaquín Blake y Joyes face an Imperial French corps under Louis Gabriel Suchet. After an inconclusive contest earlier in the day, Suchet's cavalry made a decisive charge that resulted in a French victory. Though the Spanish right wing was crushed, the rest of Blake's army got away in fairly good order after abandoning most of its artillery. María de Huerva is located 17 kilometres (10.6 mi) southwest of Zaragoza, Spain. The action occurred during the Peninsular War which was part of the larger struggle known as the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 玛丽亚战役于1809年6月15日爆发，华金·布莱克·伊·霍伊斯率领的一支小型西班牙军队与路易·加布里埃尔·絮歇指挥的法国帝国军交战。当天早些时候双方战成平手，随后絮歇的骑兵发动决定性冲锋，法军获胜。西班牙军右翼被击溃，但其余部队放弃大部分火炮后仍较有秩序地撤离。西班牙玛丽亚德韦尔瓦位于萨拉戈萨西南17公里（10.6英里）。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间，该战争属于更大规模的拿破仑战争。

en.s: The Second Battle of La Puerta (Spanish: Segunda Batalla de La Puerta) was fought between Royalists of the Spanish Empire and the Second Republic of Venezuela on 15 June 1814. It was a crushing defeat for the Republicans and a turning point in the war that led to the fall of the Second Republic of Venezuela.

zh.t: 拉普埃尔塔第二次战役
zh.s: 拉普埃尔塔第二次战役于1814年6月15日爆发，交战双方是西班牙帝国王党军和委内瑞拉第二共和国军。共和军惨败，此战成为战争转折点，并导致委内瑞拉第二共和国灭亡。

en.t: Napoleon's army crosses the Sambre to open the Waterloo campaign
en.s: On June 15, 1815, Napoleon's French Army of the North crossed the Sambre near Charleroi, in present-day Belgium, and attacked Prussian forward positions. The move opened the campaign that would culminate three days later at Waterloo.
en.n: This is the opening of hostilities, not the end of the Waterloo campaign.

zh.t: 拿破仑军队渡过桑布尔河，滑铁卢战役序幕拉开
zh.s: 1815年6月15日，拿破仑率领的法军北方军团在今比利时沙勒罗瓦附近渡过桑布尔河，进攻普鲁士军队前哨。战事由此展开，三天后双方在滑铁卢决战。
zh.n: 这一天是战事开始，不是滑铁卢战役结束。

en.s: The Auspicious Incident (or Event) (Turkish: (in Istanbul) Vaka-i Hayriye "Fortunate Event"; (in Balkans) Vaka-i Şerriyye, "Unfortunate Incident") was the forced disbandment of the centuries-old Janissary corps by Sultan Mahmud II on 15 June 1826. Most of the 135,000 Janissaries revolted against Mahmud II, and after the rebellion was suppressed, its leaders killed, and many members exiled or imprisoned, the Janissary corps was disbanded and replaced with a more modern military force.

zh.s: 吉祥事变也称吉祥事件（土耳其语：伊斯坦布尔称Vaka-i Hayriye，即“吉祥事件”；巴尔干地区称Vaka-i Şerriyye，即“不祥事件”），指苏丹马哈茂德二世于1826年6月15日强行解散有数百年历史的耶尼切里军团。约13.5万名耶尼切里军团士兵中，多数人起兵反抗马哈茂德二世。叛乱被镇压后，首领被杀，许多成员被流放或监禁，耶尼切里军团随之解散，并由一支较现代化的军队取代。

en.s: The 1843 New South Wales colonial election was held between 15 June and 3 July 1843 and was Australia's first colonial election. This election was for 24 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Council and it was conducted in 15 single-member constituencies, two 2-member constituencies and one 5-member constituency, all with a first past the post system.

zh.s: 1843年新南威尔士殖民地选举于1843年6月15日至7月3日举行，是澳大利亚首次殖民地选举。此次选举改选新南威尔士立法委员会24个席位，在15个单席位选区、两个双席位选区和一个五席位选区进行，均采用简单多数制。

en.s: The Oregon Treaty between the United Kingdom and the United States was signed on June 15, 1846, in Washington, D.C. The treaty brought an end to the Oregon boundary dispute by settling competing American and British claims to the Oregon Country through partition. The area had been jointly occupied by both Britain and the U.S. since the Treaty of 1818.

zh.s: 英国和美国于1846年6月15日在华盛顿特区签署俄勒冈条约。条约通过划分俄勒冈地区，解决美英双方对该地区的领土争端。自1818年条约签订以来，英美两国一直共同占据该地区。

en.t: William Ide issues the Bear Flag revolt's independence manifesto
en.s: William B. Ide issued a proclamation at Sonoma, California, on June 15, 1846, explaining the Bear Flag rebels' intention to establish a republican government independent of Mexico. The rebels had seized Sonoma and raised their flag the previous day. Ide's proclamation set out the movement's political aims as the revolt unfolded during the Mexican–American War.
en.n: June 15 is Ide's dated manifesto; the seizure of Sonoma and raising of the Bear Flag took place on June 14.

zh.t: 威廉·艾德发表熊旗起义独立宣言
zh.s: 1846年6月15日，威廉·艾德在索诺玛发表宣言，说明熊旗起义者打算建立脱离墨西哥的共和政府。起义者在前一天占领索诺玛并升起熊旗。这份宣言阐明了起义的政治目标；当时美墨战争正在进行，加利福尼亚仍属墨西哥。
zh.n: 6月15日是艾德宣言的署期；占领索诺玛和升起熊旗发生在6月14日。

en.s: The Battle of Treponti, also known as Battle of Castenedolo, took place on 15 June 1859, during the Second Italian War of Independence. The encounter opposed the Austrians led by Field Marshal Karl von Urban and the Sardinians commanded by Giuseppe Garibaldi. Von Urban employed a cunning stratagem that led to his victory over Garibaldi. The Battle of Treponti was the only major Austrian victory of the war.

zh.s: 特雷蓬蒂战役也称卡斯泰内多洛战役，于1859年6月15日意大利第二次独立战争期间爆发。交战双方是卡尔·冯·乌尔班元帅率领的奥军和朱塞佩·加里波第指挥的撒丁军。乌尔班运用巧妙的策略击败加里波第。这是奥地利在该战争中唯一一次重大战役胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Lututow was a clash between Polish rebel forces and units of the Imperial Russian Army. It took place during the January Uprising, on June 15, 1863, near the village of Lututow, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. Rebel forces, commanded by Antoni Korotynski were defeated by the Russians. Polish forces numbered some 120 kosynierzy, and the battle resulted in complete annihilation of Korotynski’s unit, as 64 rebels were killed and 46 were wounded. Bodies of the rebels were buried in a mass grave at the local cemetery. Location of the battle is marked by two large crosses and boulders.

zh.s: 卢图图夫战役是波兰起义军与俄罗斯帝国军队之间的一场冲突，发生于1863年6月15日一月起义期间，地点在卢图图夫村附近。当时该地属于俄罗斯控制下的波兰会议王国。安东尼·科罗廷斯基指挥的起义军被俄军击败。波军约有120名持镰刀的士兵，科罗廷斯基的部队几乎全军覆没，64名起义者死亡、46人受伤。起义者遗体被埋在当地墓地的合葬墓中。战场位置由两座大型十字架和巨石标记。

en.s: The Battle of Richmond was a minor engagement that was fought June 15, 1863, in Richmond, Louisiana, during the Siege of Vicksburg of the American Civil War.

Union forces under Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant attempted to capture Petersburg, Virginia, before Gen. Robert E. Lee's Confederate Army of Northern Virginia could reinforce the city. The four days included repeated Union assaults against substantially smaller forces commanded by Gen. P.G.T. Beauregard. zh.s: 第二次彼得斯堡之战又称彼得斯堡攻势，于1864年6月15日至18日发生在里士满—彼得斯堡战役初期。尤利西斯·格兰特中将指挥的联邦军试图在罗伯特·李将军的北弗吉尼亚邦联军增援前，夺取弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡。四天里，联邦军多次进攻由P.G.T.博雷加德将军指挥、人数远少于己方的守军。博雷加德布置了坚固防线，联邦军将领的行动又协调不力，尤其是威廉·F.史密斯少将错失了6月15日最好的进攻机会。

en.s: The Battle of Gilgal Church (June 15, 1864) was an action during the Atlanta campaign in the American Civil War. The Union army of William Tecumseh Sherman and the Confederate army led by Joseph E. Johnston fought a series of battles between June 10 and 19 along a front stretching northeast from Lost Mountain to Pine Mountain to Brushy Mountain.

zh.s: 吉尔加尔教堂战役发生于1864年6月15日，是美国内战亚特兰大战役的一部分。威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼指挥的联邦军与约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿率领的邦联军于6月10日至19日在一条从洛斯特山延伸到派恩山、再到布拉希山的战线上展开一系列战斗。

en.t: Ambush of the steamboat J. R. Williams
en.s: The ambush of the steamboat J.R. Williams was a military engagement during the American Civil War. It took place on June 15, 1864, on the Arkansas River in the Choctaw Nation (Indian Territory) which became encompassed by the State of Oklahoma. It is popularly termed the "only naval battle" in that landlocked state. It was a successful Confederate attack on the Union Army's lines of supply.

zh.t: 袭击蒸汽船J·R·威廉姆斯号
zh.s: 袭击蒸汽船J·R·威廉姆斯号是美国内战期间的一场军事交战，于1864年6月15日在印第安领地乔克托族地区的阿肯色河上发生；该地区后来并入俄克拉何马州。此战通常被称为这个内陆州“唯一的海战”。邦联军成功袭击了联邦军的补给线。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 15 June 1893. Despite the Social Democratic Party (SPD) receiving a plurality of votes, the Centre Party remained the largest party in the Reichstag after winning 96 of the 397 seats, whilst the SPD won just 44. Voter turnout was 72.4%.

zh.s: 德国于1893年6月15日举行联邦选举。尽管社会民主党（SPD）获得最多选票，中央党仍以397席中的96席成为国会最大党，社会民主党仅获44席。投票率为72.4%。

en.s: An 8.5 magnitude earthquake occurred at 19:32 (local time) on June 15, 1896, on the Sanriku coast in Honshu, Japan. It resulted in two tsunami waves which destroyed about 9,000 homes and caused at least 22,000 deaths. It was one of the most destructive seismic events in Japanese history.

zh.s: 1896年6月15日当地时间19时32分，日本本州三陆海岸发生8.5级地震。地震引发两次海啸，摧毁约9,000栋房屋，造成至少22,000人死亡。这是日本历史上破坏最严重的地震灾害之一。

en.s: The Battle of Te-li-ssu (得利寺の戦い Tokuriji no tatakai), also called Battle of Wafangou (Russian: Бой у Вафангоу) after the nearby railway station, was a land battle of the Russo-Japanese War. The battle was fought on 14–15 June 1904 between the Japanese Second Army under General Oku Yasukata and the Russian First Siberian Army Corps under Lieutenant General Georgii Stackelberg, at a hamlet some 80 mi (130 km) north of Port Arthur, Manchuria.

en.s: The Hitachi Maru Incident (常陸丸事件, Hitachi-maru jiken) was a maritime incident which occurred during the Russo-Japanese War of 1904–1905, in which three Japanese military transports were sunk in a Russian commerce raiding sortie by a Vladivostok-based armored cruiser squadron of the Imperial Russian Navy.

en.s: The Taumarunui by-election of 1915 was a by-election during the 18th New Zealand Parliament in the Taumarunui electorate. It was held on the 15 June 1915. The seat had become vacant in May 1915 when incumbent Taumarunui MP's William Jennings' election the previous year was declared void. Jennings stood again and successfully retained his seat.

en.s: The Raid on Ruhnu on 15 June 1917 was a minor operation proceeded by Imperial German Naval Air Forces in Ruhnu Island in the Gulf of Riga during World War I. Several German seaplanes landed on the coast of Ruhnu to attack the Russian telegraph station and after that retreated to their home base, which is considered as the first air-landing ambush operation in the military history.

zh.s: 1917年6月15日，德意志帝国海军航空兵在第一次世界大战期间对里加湾的鲁努岛发动了一次小规模行动。数架德国水上飞机在岛岸降落，袭击俄军电报站后返回基地。这被视为军事史上首次以飞机降落实施的伏击行动。

en.s: The Plymouth Drake by-election of 1937 was held on 15 June 1937. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Conservative MP, Frederick Guest. It was won by the Conservative candidate Henry Guest.

en.s: The Masļenki border incident (Latvian: Masļenku robežincidents) was an attack by Soviet NKVD troops on 15 June 1940 against the Latvian border posts in the district of Abrene at the then Latvian–Soviet border on the eve of the Soviet occupation of Latvia. The incident in fact consisted of three separate nearly simultaneously launched attacks on Latvian border posts by Soviet forces at the early dawn of June 15, 1940.

zh.s: 马斯连基边境事件是苏联内务人民委员部部队于1940年6月15日袭击拉脱维亚边境哨所的事件，地点在阿布雷内地区、当时的拉脱维亚—苏联边境。袭击发生在苏联占领拉脱维亚前夕，实际上包括三起几乎同时发起的袭击，均于1940年6月15日黎明时分发生。

en.s: The 1940 Coppa Italia final was the final of the 1939–40 Coppa Italia. The match was played on 15 June 1940 between Fiorentina and Genova 1893. Fiorentina won 1–0.

zh.s: 1940年意大利杯决赛是1939—40赛季意大利杯的决赛，于1940年6月15日举行，对阵双方是佛罗伦萨队和热那亚1893队。佛罗伦萨以1比0获胜。

en.s: Operation Aerial was the evacuation of Allied military forces and civilians from ports in western France. The operation took place from 15 to 25 June 1940 during the Second World War. The embarkation followed the Allied military collapse in the Battle of France against Nazi Germany. Operation Dynamo, the evacuation from Dunkirk and Operation Cycle from Le Havre, had finished on 13 June.
en.n: World War II: Operation Aerial begins: Allied troops start to evacuate France, following Germany's takeover of Paris and most of the nation.

Sidon, a town of about 12,000 people at the time with a number of historic mosques and castles dating back to the Crusades, was positioned on the coast to the north of Tyre, about halfway between the Lebanese border with Palestine and Beirut.

en.s: Mission Albany was a parachute combat assault at night by the U.S. 101st Airborne Division on June 6, 1944, part of the American airborne landings in Normandy during World War II. It was the opening step of Operation Neptune, the assault portion of the Allied invasion of Normandy, Operation Overlord. en.s: Operation Inmate was a British Pacific Fleet attack against Japanese positions on Truk Atoll in the central Pacific Ocean during World War II. The attacks against the lightly-defended islands on 14 and 15 June 1945 were conducted to provide combat experience for the aircraft carrier HMS Implacable and several of the fleet's cruisers and destroyers ahead of their involvement in more demanding operations off Japan. On 14 June 1945 British aircraft conducted a series of raids against Japanese positions at Truk. During the next morning several islands in the atoll were bombarded by cruisers, though only one of the four warships involved achieved any success.

zh.s: 囚徒行动是第二次世界大战期间英国太平洋舰队对中太平洋特鲁克环礁日军阵地发起的攻击。1945年6月14日和15日，英军袭击防守薄弱的岛屿，为“不屈”号航空母舰及数艘巡洋舰和驱逐舰积累实战经验，以备之后参与对日作战。1945年6月14日，英国飞机空袭特鲁克日军阵地。次日上午，数艘巡洋舰炮击环礁内的多个岛屿，但4艘参战军舰中只有1艘取得战果。

en.s: The Battle of Bessang Pass was fought from 9 January through 15 June 1945 in Cervantes, a municipality in the province of Ilocos Sur, located 260 km north of Manila. The area serves as a gateway to the Cordillera mountains and the city of Baguio. Bessang Pass was a stronghold of the Japanese imperial forces under Gen. Tomoyuki Yamashita, known as the “Tiger of Malaya” and conqueror of Singapore. It was part of the triangular defense of General Yamashita in the north, namely the Balete Pass, Villaverde Trail and Bessang Pass, guarding the Ifugao-Benguet-Vizcaya borders.

zh.s: 贝桑山口战役于1945年1月9日至6月15日在菲律宾伊罗戈斯苏尔省的塞万提斯市镇展开，该地位于马尼拉以北260公里，是通往科迪勒拉山脉和碧瑶市的门户。贝桑山口是日军据点，由以“马来亚之虎”、新加坡征服者闻名的山下奉文将军指挥。该地属于山下在北部设置的三角防线之一，另外两处是巴莱特山口和维拉维德山道，用来守卫伊富高、本格特和新比斯开省的边界。

en.s: The 1969 French presidential election took place on 1 June and 15 June 1969. It occurred due to the resignation of President Charles de Gaulle on 28 April 1969. Indeed, De Gaulle had decided to consult the voters by referendum about regionalisation and the reform of the Senate, and he had announced he would resign if it resulted in a "no" vote. In the presidential election, the Gaullist Party (Union of Democrats for the Republic, UDR) was represented by former Prime Minister Georges Pompidou.

en.s: The Spanish general election of 1977 took place on 15 June 1977. It was the first election since the death of Francisco Franco. The previous general election was held in 1936, prior to the outbreak of the Spanish Civil War. Voting was on the basis of universal suffrage in a secret ballot. The elections were held using closed list proportional representation in 52 electoral districts corresponding to the 50 provinces of Spain and the African enclaves of Ceuta and Melilla. The largest districts Barcelona, Madrid and Valencia elected 32, 31 and 15 members respectively. Other districts elected from 3 to 12 members.

en.s: The Glasgow Central by-election, in the Glasgow Central constituency, Scotland, was held on 15 June 1989. It was caused by the death of the sitting Member of Parliament for the constituency, Bob McTaggart. The Scottish National Party (SNP) had high hopes of repeating their victory from the previous year at the by-election for the Glasgow Govan seat, and they chose as their candidate a close associate of their Govan victor, Jim Sillars in Alex Neil. However, the hoped for victory did not transpire for the SNP, as Mike Watson retained the seat for the Labour Party with a 6,462 majority, despite a 20.3% rise in the SNP share of the votes cast.

zh.s: 苏格兰格拉斯哥中区国会议席于1989年6月15日举行补选，起因是现任议员鲍勃·麦克塔加特去世。苏格兰民族党原本希望重现前一年格拉斯哥戈万选区补选的胜利，因此提名与戈万胜选者吉姆·西拉斯关系密切的亚历克斯·尼尔参选。不过该党未能如愿，工党的迈克·沃森以6,462票多数保住席位，尽管苏格兰民族党的得票占比增加了20.3%。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom House of Commons was held in the constituency of Vauxhall on 15 June 1989, following the resignation of sitting Member of Parliament (MP) Stuart Holland. The winner, Kate Hoey, was Minister for Sport in Tony Blair's Labour government from 1999-2001 before returning to the backbenches. The 1989 by-election was caused by Stuart Holland's resignation to take up an academic job in preference to remaining in the Labour Party. Kate Hoey was shortlisted for the seat against the wishes of many left-wing local Labour activists who wanted Nigerian-born Martha Osamor.

zh.s: 英国下议院沃克斯霍尔选区于1989年6月15日举行补选，起因是现任议员斯图尔特·霍兰辞职。获胜者凯特·霍伊后来于1999至2001年在托尼·布莱尔的工党政府中担任体育部长，之后回到后座议员席位。霍兰辞职是为了接受学术职位，而不是继续留在工党。尽管许多当地左翼工党活动人士反对，霍伊仍入围候选名单；他们希望由尼日利亚出生的玛莎·奥萨莫尔参选。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1989 was held on Thursday 15 June 1989, three weeks after the dissolution of the Dáil on 25 May. en.t: 1989 European Parliament election in the United Kingdom
en.s: The 1989 European Parliament election, was the third European election to be held in the United Kingdom. It was held on 15 June. en.s: The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo in the Philippines' Luzon Volcanic Arc was the second-largest volcanic eruption of the 20th century, behind only the 1912 eruption of Novarupta in Alaska. Eruptive activity began on April 2 as a series of phreatic explosions from a fissure that opened on the north side of Mount Pinatubo. Seismographs were set up and began monitoring the volcano for earthquakes. In late May, the number of seismic events under the volcano fluctuated from day-to-day. Beginning June 6, a swarm of progressively shallower earthquakes accompanied by inflationary tilt on the upper east flank of the mountain, culminated in the extrusion of a small lava dome. On June 12, the volcano's first spectacular eruption sent an ash column 19 km (12 mi) into the atmosphere. Additional explosions occurred overnight and the morning of June 13. Seismic activity during this period became intense. When even more highly gas-charged magma reached Pinatubo's surface on June 15, 1991, the volcano exploded, sending an ash cloud 40 km (25 mi) into the atmosphere.

zh.s: 菲律宾吕宋火山弧上的皮纳图博火山于1991年喷发，是20世纪规模第二大的火山喷发，仅次于1912年阿拉斯加诺瓦鲁普塔火山喷发。喷发活动于4月2日开始，皮纳图博山北侧裂缝出现一系列蒸汽爆炸。随后架设了地震仪监测火山活动。5月下旬，火山下方的地震活动数量每天都有波动。6月6日起，越来越浅的地震活动和山体东侧上部膨胀同时出现，最终形成一个小型熔岩穹丘。6月12日，火山首次大规模喷发，灰柱升至19公里（12英里）高空。6月13日夜间和14日上午又发生多次爆炸，期间地震活动加剧。1991年6月15日，含气量更高的岩浆抵达地表，火山猛烈喷发，灰云升至40公里（25英里）高空。

The event took place on June 15, 1996 at the International Amphitheatre in Orizaba, Veracruz, Mexico. en.s: The 1996 Manchester bombing was an attack carried out by the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) on Saturday 15 June 1996. The IRA detonated a powerful 3,300-pound (1,500 kg) truck bomb on Corporation Street in the centre of Manchester, England. The biggest bomb detonated in Great Britain since World War II, it targeted the city's infrastructure and economy and caused devastating damage, estimated by insurers at £700 million (£1.2 billion as of 2017). The IRA had sent telephoned warnings about 90 minutes before the bomb detonated.

zh.s: 临时爱尔兰共和军（IRA）于1996年6月15日星期六在英格兰曼彻斯特市中心发动袭击，引爆了一枚重3,300磅（1,500公斤）的汽车炸弹。这是第二次世界大战以来在英国境内爆炸威力最大的炸弹，目标是城市基础设施和经济，造成严重破坏。保险公司估计损失达7亿英镑（按2017年币值约为12亿英镑）。炸弹爆炸前约90分钟，IRA曾通过电话发出警告。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Croatia on 15 June 1997. They were the second presidential elections held since independence in 1991. The result was a victory for incumbent president Franjo Tuđman of the Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ), who received 61.4% of the vote and was re-elected to a second five-year term. Voter turnout was 54.6%. The elections featured the lowest number of presidential candidates to date, with only three taking part; Tuđman, Zdravko Tomac and Vlado Gotovac. The margin of victory (over 40%) is also the largest to date. Tuđman took the oath of office for a second term on 5 August 1997 at Saint Mark's Square.

en.s: Operation Zarb-e-Azb (Urdu: آپریشن ضربِ عضب‎ ALA-LC: Āpres̱ẖan Ẓarb-i ʿAẓb pronounced [ɑːpreːʃən zərb-e əzb]) is a joint military offensive conducted by the Pakistan Armed Forces against various militant groups, including the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), the Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, the East Turkestan Islamic Movement, Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, al-Qaeda, Jundallah and the Haqqani network. The operation was launched on 15 June 2014 in North Waziristan along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border as a renewed effort against militancy in the wake of the 8 June attack on Jinnah International Airport in Karachi, for which the TTP and the IMU claimed responsibility.

zh.s: 2024年Clash at the Castle也以Clash at the Castle：苏格兰为宣传名称，是由美国职业摔角推广组织WWE制作的按次付费及网络直播赛事，参赛者来自Raw和SmackDown两个主力品牌。这是第二届Clash at the Castle，于2024年6月15日在苏格兰格拉斯哥的OVO Hydro体育馆举行。

en.s: The United National Congress's internal elections took place on 15 June 2024. Members of the National Executive (NATEX) of the party were elected, with the exception of the office of political leader. The candidates were split between two teams: Star led by Kamla Persad-Bissessar, the party's current political leader, Opposition Leader of Trinidad and Tobago, and MP for Siparia, and United Patriots led by Rushton Paray, the MP for Mayaro.

zh.s: 联合国民大会党于2024年6月15日举行党内选举，选出该党国家执行委员会（NATEX）成员，但政治领袖职位除外。候选人分属两个团队：“星辰”团队由时任该党政治领袖、特立尼达和多巴哥反对党领袖及西帕里亚选区议员卡姆拉·佩萨德-比塞萨尔带领；“团结爱国者”团队由马亚罗选区议员拉什顿·帕雷带领。

en.s: UFC on ESPN: Perez vs. Taira (also known as UFC on ESPN 58 and UFC Vegas 93) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on June 15, 2024, at the UFC Apex facility, in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

en.t: Bangkok United wins the Thai FA Cup final on penalties
en.s: On June 15, 2024, Bangkok United defeated Dragon Pathumwan Kanchanaburi on penalties in the Thai FA Cup final in Ratchaburi, Thailand. After a 1–1 draw following extra time, Bangkok United won the shootout 4–1.

zh.t: 曼谷联赢得泰国足总杯冠军
zh.s: 2024年6月15日，泰国足总杯决赛在叻丕府举行。曼谷联与北碧府龙队（Dragon Pathumwan Kanchanaburi）加时赛后战成1比1，曼谷联随后以4比1赢得点球大战。

en.s: The 2024 Annecy International Animation Film Festival took place from 9 to 15 June 2024, in Annecy, France. Michel Hazanavicius' drama film The Most Precious of Cargoes, adapted from the novel of the same name by Jean-Claude Grumberg, served as the opening film. Australian film Memoir of a Snail, directed by Adam Elliot, won the Cristal Award for Best Feature Film, while Spanish film Sultana's Dream, directed by Isabel Herguera, won the Contrechamp Grand Prix.

en.t: 2025 Democratic Party of Wisconsin chairmanship election
en.s: The 2025 Democratic Party of Wisconsin chairmanship election was held on June 15, 2025, to elect the chairperson of the Democratic Party of Wisconsin (DPW) for a two-year term. The incumbent chair, Ben Wikler, declined to run for a fourth term. The election took place at the party's annual convention in Wisconsin Dells, Wisconsin. Only registered delegates to the convention were eligible to vote; the election was conducted with ranked-choice voting.

zh.t: 2025年威斯康星州民主党主席选举
zh.s: 威斯康星州民主党于2025年6月15日举行主席选举，选出任期两年的党主席。时任主席本·维克勒没有寻求第四个任期。选举在威斯康星戴尔斯举行的该党年度大会上进行，只有大会注册代表有资格投票，并采用排序选择投票制。
